title: Grant check request (DEC-0037, DEC-0039)
description: What a callee sends the meter's grant-check capability before it spends. The caller is proven by the onward delegation token in the request's Authorization header (aud the meter, scope the grant-check capability, effect none: DL-21), never by a field here; the request carries the amount and, for attribution, the jti of the token the callee itself was called with.

amountUsd.description: The amount to reserve, in USD.

tokenJti.description: The jti of the delegation token the callee was called with: the call this spend belongs to.

grantRef.description: Which of the token's grants, when it names several.

purpose.description: One line a person can read; no prompt, output or identity.
